title: NULL rwlock dereference in CRYPTO_secure_used when secure heap is not initialized
notes: Generated C PoC artifact. strict_reproduction=false until tested against the original affected OpenSSL version.
validation_notes: Compiled successfully against system OpenSSL 3.0.13. Normal execution triggered SIGSEGV with exit code 139. Valgrind reported Invalid read of size 4 and ERROR SUMMARY: 1 errors from 1 contexts. This is local artifact validation, not strict reproduction against the original affected version.
